heading.en: Why does ice melt on its own?

hook.en: Ice melting in a glass absorbs heat, yet it happens all by itself. So “giving out heat” cannot be the only thing that drives change. The other driver is entropy, the spreading out of energy and matter.
hook.kn: ಲೋಟದಲ್ಲಿನ ಮಂಜುಗಡ್ಡೆ ಉಷ್ಣ ಹೀರಿ ಕರಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೂ ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಉಷ್ಣ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ಕಾರಣವಲ್ಲ. ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಕಾರಣ ಎಂಟ್ರೊಪಿ—ಶಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರವ್ಯದ ಹರಡುವಿಕೆ.

objectives.en: Explain entropy and the second law
Use ΔG = ΔH − TΔS to predict spontaneity
Relate ΔG° to the equilibrium constant

narration.en: Ice melting in a glass absorbs heat, yet it happens all by itself. So “giving out heat” cannot be the only thing that drives change. The other driver is entropy, the spreading out of energy and matter.
narration.kn: ಲೋಟದಲ್ಲಿನ ಮಂಜುಗಡ್ಡೆ ಉಷ್ಣ ಹೀರಿ ಕರಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೂ ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಉಷ್ಣ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ಕಾರಣವಲ್ಲ. ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಕಾರಣ ಎಂಟ್ರೊಪಿ—ಶಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರವ್ಯದ ಹರಡುವಿಕೆ.

body.en: A spontaneous process takes place on its own without outside help. Entropy S is a measure of the disorder or randomness of a system; it increases from solid to liquid to gas and when a solid dissolves or a gas expands. For heat absorbed reversibly at temperature T, ΔS = q$_{rev}$/T. Second law: for a spontaneous process the total entropy of the system and surroundings increases, ΔS$_{total}$ > 0.
body.kn: ಹೊರಗಿನ ಸಹಾಯವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಡೆಯುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಸ್ವಯಂಪ್ರೇರಿತ. ಎಂಟ್ರೊಪಿ ಅವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ಅಳತೆ; ಘನ < ದ್ರವ < ಅನಿಲ. ಎರಡನೇ ನಿಯಮ: ಸ್ವಯಂಪ್ರೇರಿತ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಟ್ಟು ಎಂಟ್ರೊಪಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: A spontaneous process happens on its own. Entropy measures disorder, and it increases from solid to liquid to gas. For any spontaneous process, the total entropy of the system and surroundings increases.
narration.kn: ಹೊರಗಿನ ಸಹಾಯವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಡೆಯುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಸ್ವಯಂಪ್ರೇರಿತ. ಎಂಟ್ರೊಪಿ ಅವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ಅಳತೆ; ಘನ < ದ್ರವ < ಅನಿಲ. ಎರಡನೇ ನಿಯಮ: ಸ್ವಯಂಪ್ರೇರಿತ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಟ್ಟು ಎಂಟ್ರೊಪಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Entropy measures disorder. It rises from solid to liquid to gas, as the particles get more freedom.
Gibbs energy combines enthalpy and entropy. Delta G equals delta H minus T delta S; a negative delta G means the process is spontaneous.
Limestone decomposition has delta H plus 178 kilojoules and delta S plus 160 joules per kelvin. Delta G falls with temperature and crosses zero near 1112 kelvin.
Delta G standard is linked to the equilibrium constant: delta G equals minus 2.303 R T log K. Negative delta G means K greater than one.

narration.en: Set ΔH and ΔS and drag the temperature. A process is spontaneous when ΔG is negative. When ΔH and ΔS have the same sign, the sign of ΔG changes at T = ΔH/ΔS.
narration.kn: ΔH, ΔS ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ ತಾಪ ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ. ΔG ಋಣವಾದಾಗ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಸ್ವಯಂಪ್ರೇರಿತ. ΔH, ΔS ಒಂದೇ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯಾದರೆ T = ΔH/ΔS ನಲ್ಲಿ ΔG ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Gibbs energy G = H − TS combines both drivers. At constant temperature and pressure, ΔG = ΔH − TΔS. ΔG < 0: spontaneous; ΔG > 0: non-spontaneous; ΔG = 0: at equilibrium. If ΔH < 0 and ΔS > 0, the reaction is spontaneous at all temperatures; if ΔH > 0 and ΔS < 0, never; if both are negative, only at low T; if both are positive, only at high T (above T = ΔH/ΔS). At equilibrium, ΔrG° = −RT ln K = −2.303 RT log K.
body.kn: ಗಿಬ್ಸ್ ಶಕ್ತಿ G = H − TS. ΔG = ΔH − TΔS. ΔG < 0 ಆದರೆ ಸ್ವಯಂಪ್ರೇರಿತ, ΔG = 0 ಆದರೆ ಸಮತೋಲನ. ΔG° = −2.303 RT log K.

points.en: ΔH +, ΔS +: spontaneous above T = ΔH/ΔS

narration.en: Gibbs energy combines enthalpy and entropy: delta G equals delta H minus T delta S. A negative delta G means the process is spontaneous, and at equilibrium the standard Gibbs energy equals minus 2.303 R T log K.

problem.en: For a reaction ΔH = +30 kJ mol⁻¹ and ΔS = +100 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. Above what temperature is it spontaneous?

steps.en: Spontaneous when ΔG = ΔH − TΔS < 0, i.e. T > ΔH/ΔS.
T = 30 000 J mol⁻¹ / 100 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ = 300 K.
The reaction is spontaneous above 300 K.

heading.en: The four sign cases of ΔG = ΔH − TΔS

body.en: ΔH −, ΔS +: always spontaneous. ΔH +, ΔS −: never spontaneous. ΔH −, ΔS −: spontaneous at low T. ΔH +, ΔS +: spontaneous at high T. When the signs disagree with each other, temperature decides.

narration.en: The four sign cases of ΔG = ΔH − TΔS. ΔH −, ΔS +: always spontaneous. ΔH +, ΔS −: never spontaneous. ΔH −, ΔS −: spontaneous at low T. ΔH +, ΔS +: spontaneous at high T. When the signs disagree with each other, temperature decides.

mnemonic.en: Heat out + disorder up = always; heat in + order up = never

narration.en: A reaction has ΔH = +40 kJ/mol and ΔS = +108 J/(K mol). Find the temperature at which it just becomes spontaneous (ΔG = 0).

prompt.en: A reaction has ΔH = +40 kJ/mol and ΔS = +108 J/(K mol). Find the temperature at which it just becomes spontaneous (ΔG = 0).

hint.en: Use the same units: ΔS = 0.108 kJ/(K mol).

explanation.en: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS = 0 gives T = 40 000 / 108 ≈ 370 K. Above it ΔG < 0.
